use_case_summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary goal: power semantic search across user docs and product release notes, plus product recommendations and reranking. Heavy nightly batch ingest of user events -> embeddings. Need low-latency vector lookups for feature in-app search.
technical_requirements: Target sustained embedding throughput: 50k vectors/hour (peak bursts to 100k/hr)
Embedding dimension: 1536 (current model), testing quantized 8-bit variants to reduce cost
Batch job cadence: nightly bulk of ~600k rows, delta streams throughout day (~12k/hr)
Vector DB: evaluate Weaviate + managed Postgres hybrid store; must support incremental upserts and soft deletes
Latency SLO for in-app semantic search: <120ms P95 for top-k retrieval from closest vector candidates
Retry/fallback: fallback to smaller model or cached top results during capacity congestion
Observability: token-level cost, per-route latency, per-embedding cost breakdowns required
poc_notes: POC split into two phases. Phase 1 (hosted) validated model quality and integration patterns using Hosted API + Pinecone prototype. Phase 2 (planned) Dedicated throughput POC: isolate GPU pools, run sustained embedding generator, measure KV cache impact and batching. Client asked for explicit per-hour committed pricing and SLA for latency.
pricing_notes: Janus economics sensitive to per-embedding cost — internal threshold ~ $0.0008/vector. Interested in committed monthly capacity (3-6 month) to get discounted rates. Asked for line-item breakdown: GPU-hours, storage, vector DB egress.
